title: khaa gaye shaam ke zinda'n me andhere baba
body:
azadaro'n dua maango koi aise yateem na ho
jaise sakina yateem hui
shaam ke zinda'n me jab sakina ko baba ka sar mila
lipta ke sar ko seene se bachi ne ye kaha
kha gaye sham ke zinda'n me andhere baba
kisko kehte hai yateemi ye suna tha maine
aap ke baad ye ehsaas hua hai baba
<<MINI>>
kha gaye sham ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad yateemi ki saza paayi hai
itni tanha hu ke saaya hai na parchayi hai
raat ro ro ke guzarti hai to din matam me
qaid khane me yuhi'n saal kata hai baba
<<MINI>>
kha gaye sham ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi meri dukho'n se hai ibarat baba
kaise qismat ne dihkhayi hai musibat baba
mai jo roti hoo to lagte hai tamachay baba
aap ki yaad me rona bhi saza hai baba
<<MINI>>
kha gaye sham ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk aankho'n se nikalte hai lahoo kano se
ab darindo se nahi khauf hai insano se
ek majboor yateema par sitam dhaate hai
meri taqdeer me durro ki jafa hai baba
<<MINI>>
kha gaye sham ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki tarha se roothe hai ujaale baba
kaun zindan se ab mujhko nikaale baba
tumne maanga tha duao'n me khuda se jisko
ab wohi beti hai zinda'n me jafa hai baba
<<MINI>>
kha gaye sham ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne armaa'n the ke zinda'n se mai ghar jaungi
aisa lagta hai yahi'n ro ro ke marjaungi
ye sitamgaar sakina ko kafan kya denge
kya kafan aap ke laashe ko mila hai baba
<<MINI>>
kha gaye sham ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
baba kehte hai ye zinda'n ke andhere mujhse
maut hi aayegi ab mujhko dilaase dene
meri har saans hi rehti hai sitam ki zad par
aise jeene se to marna hi bhala hai baba
<<MINI>>
kha gaye sham ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhm laakho'n hai kaleje me dikhau'n kaise
mujhpe jo beeth rahi hai wo batau'n kaise
pyas lagti hai to peeleti hoo aansu apne
shimr ke durre sakina ki ghiza hai baba
<<MINI>>
kha gaye sham ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
lafz mazhar ne jo likhe hai lahoo rote hai
shadma'n qaak se yu ashke aza behte hai
aisa lagta hai ke zinda'n se sada aati hai
aisa nauha meri ghurbat pe likha hai baba
<<MINI>>
kha gaye sham ke....
